mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM sales_out WHERE create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 1) as todaySalesAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM purchase_in WHERE create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 1) as todayPurchaseAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_in WHERE create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 1) as todayReceiveAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_out WHERE create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 1) as todayPaymentAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM sales_out WHERE create_time::date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND status = 1) as monthSalesAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM purchase_in WHERE create_time::date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND status = 1) as monthPurchaseAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM inventory) as totalInventoryCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory i JOIN product p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.quantity <= p.min_stock) as warningInventoryCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 0) as pendingPurchaseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE status = 0) as pendingSalesCount

SELECT CURRENT_DATE as reportDate, 'daily' as reportType, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as totalSalesAmount, COUNT(*) as totalOrderCount, COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount, 0 as discountAmount, 0 as returnAmount FROM sales_out WHERE create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 1

SELECT CURRENT_DATE as reportDate, 'daily' as reportType, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as totalPurchaseAmount, COUNT(*) as totalOrderCount, COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount, 0 as returnAmount FROM purchase_in WHERE create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 1

SELECT i.id, i.product_id as productId, i.product_name as productName, i.product_code as productCode, i.warehouse_name as warehouseName, i.quantity, p.min_stock as minQuantity, i.cost as unitPrice FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN product p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.quantity <= p.min_stock ORDER BY i.quantity ASC

SELECT i.id, i.product_id as productId, i.product_name as productName, i.product_code as productCode, i.warehouse_name as warehouseName, i.quantity, i.cost as unitPrice, CURRENT_DATE - i.create_time::date as idleDays FROM inventory i WHERE i.quantity > 0 AND CURRENT_DATE - i.create_time::date >= #{days} ORDER BY idleDays DESC

SELECT CURRENT_DATE as reportDate, 'summary' as reportType, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_in WHERE status = 1) as totalIncome, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_out WHERE status = 1) as totalExpense, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE status = 1) as accountCount

SELECT c.id as customerId, c.customer_name as customerName, COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0) as totalSalesAmount, COUNT(so.id) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0) as totalReceivable, COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0) as receivedAmount, 0 as pendingAmount, MAX(so.create_time) as lastOrderDate, 100 as paymentRate, c.level as customerLevel FROM customer c LEFT JOIN sales_out so ON c.id = so.customer_id AND so.status = 1 WHERE c.id = #{customerId} GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name, c.level

SELECT s.id as supplierId, s.supplier_name as supplierName, COALESCE(SUM(pi.total_amount), 0) as totalPurchaseAmount, COUNT(pi.id) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(pi.total_amount), 0) as totalPayable, COALESCE(SUM(pi.total_amount), 0) as paidAmount, 0 as pendingAmount, MAX(pi.create_time) as lastOrderDate, 100 as paymentRate, 0 as supplierLevel FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN purchase_in pi ON s.id = pi.supplier_id AND pi.status = 1 WHERE s.id = #{supplierId} GROUP BY s.id, s.supplier_name
